data.__transform:
($isNilOrEmpty(data.productionSetupOutput.standardRate)
	? "No Rate Data"
	: (
		$total := $sum($$
			.data
			.productionSetupOutput
			.productionSetup
			.setupMaterials
			.edges
			.node
			.inventory[
				productStrategyProcessId
					= $$.data.componentProductStrategyProcessId
			]
			.quantity
			.value);
      
		$remaining := $isNilOrEmpty($total)
			? 0
			: $coalesce([data.standardUsage, 0])
				* $coalesce([data.productionSetupOutput.remainingBalance, 0])
				- $total;
        
     $standardRate := $coalesce([data.productionSetupOutput.standardRate, 0]);
		 $result := $standardRate= 0? 0 :  ($coalesce([$total, 0]) / $standardRate) * 60;  
      
		 $remaining < 0
			? $round(0 - $remaining, 2) & " Units Excess"
			: $round($result, 0) & " mins remaining"
	))
